gaps.title: Vehicle-agnostic autonomous-systems orchestration layer (the AVO problem: tasking and coordinating heterogeneous multi-vendor uncrewed vehicles across domains)
gaps.problem: No fielded, government-owned or neutral layer can task and coordinate heterogeneous autonomous vehicles from multiple vendors across domains, so DIU, DAWG and the Navy are paying a prize challenge for one.
gaps.user: DAWG and SOCOM planners, Navy unmanned task units, Army launched-effects commanders

gaps.title: ACE dispersed-base sortie-generation logistics C2 under degraded communications (decentralized fuel, munitions, spares and airmen decisions at hub-and-spoke locations)
gaps.problem: Air Force dispersed operations need decentralized, risk-informed logistics decisions when cut off from centralized maintenance and supply systems, and no fielded software supports it.
gaps.user: Wing A4 staff, Logistics Readiness Squadron and Maintenance Group leaders at ACE hub-and-spoke locations, PACAF/USAFE A4

gaps.title: Low-to-high software and model promotion with reusable accreditation, low-SWaP software-defined cross-domain at the edge, and bridging BICES intelligence to MPE mission-command networks
gaps.problem: Moving containerized applications, models and intelligence products across classification and coalition boundaries (unclassified factories to Secret/TS, tactical CDS for voice/video/ML outputs, BICES to MPE) depends on approved media, NCDSMO-baselined guards and re-accreditation, so each classified update or cross-enclave product is slow, manual and program-specific.
gaps.user: Software-factory release engineers, ISSMs on SIPR/JWICS enclaves, program offices fielding at IL6+, tactical CDS operators, expeditionary targeting cells, multinational intelligence cells and G2/J2 staff

gaps.title: Build a competing general-purpose military data fabric / data mesh platform
gaps.problem: Services still lack a single interoperable data fabric across echelons and domains, which superficially suggests room for a new platform.
gaps.user: Program offices seeking an alternative to Anduril/Palantir lock-in
